data.body: **P2 — Preserve explicit exception details when the `ErrorObject` is empty.** This returns false even when a public `DurableOperationException` has an explicit message, cause, or suppressed failure. Virtual child contexts pass that original exception to `onOperationEnd`, so both plugins incorrectly leave the failed span `UNSET` and omit its exception event. Suppress telemetry only when both the container and the exception’s own diagnostic fields are empty, and add virtual-operation tests for an empty container with an explicit message and cause.
